app.name: Duplicate Escrow
app.summary: A deliberately wrong design that reimplements escrow instead of reusing r-sure.

uniqueValue: A new escrow engine, which is the anti-pattern the gate must refuse.

components.whyUnique: Claims to be unique, but it is commodity escrow.

conservation.assertion: the released amount equals the funded amount

concurrency.mechanism: the escrow cell is consumed once

acceptance.then: it is refused with r-sure as the existing primitive
